By combining official mission archives with live NASA APIs, AstroBot AI turns static historical records into an interactive storytelling tool that lets users explore the discoveries and legacies of NASA’s spacecraft, probes, and rovers.
AstroBot AI is an intelligent, fact-grounded conversational assistant designed to make complex space science and real-time NASA mission data accessible to everyone. By combining a curated knowledge base of official NASA technical reports with live API integrations, it eliminates AI hallucinations and provides verified, cited answers to astronomy and space exploration questions.


The Problem
Standard AI chatbots often struggle with specialized space science questions. They frequently hallucinate scientific facts, rely on outdated training data, and lack direct access to live telemetry or peer-reviewed space agency publications. For students, educators, and space enthusiasts, finding accurate, verifiable answers across massive archives of technical NASA PDFs can be overwhelming.
Our Solution & How It Works
Astrobot AI solves this problem using a custom Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture paired with live Python tool execution:
• Curated NASA Knowledge Base: The system is grounded in a specialized document vault of official NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS) publications, covering historic milestones such as the Hubble Space Telescope’s 25-year discoveries, the Galileo mission to Jupiter, planetary geology, and 50 years of solar system exploration. When a user asks a scientific question, the AI searches these documents and cites the exact source PDF.Live NASA API Integration: Through custom-built Python tools, the assistant connects directly to official NASA Open APIs (api.nasa.gov). Users can request real-time data, such as the Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) or live Near-Earth Asteroid tracking, directly inside the conversation.Strict Anti-Hallucination Guardrails:

The underlying language model is governed by a custom system configuration (exported as a structured YML profile)

Impact & Future Scalability
AstroBot AI bridges the gap between raw, complex space agency archives and everyday curiosity. While currently built as a streamlined prototype, this modular architecture can easily scale to ingest thousands of additional NASA datasets, mission logs, and live satellite telemetry—serving as an interactive educational companion for classrooms or a rapid research assistant for scientists.

1.Astrobot_model.yml (AI Agent Configuration & Guardrails)
◦ Purpose: This YML file contains the complete structural profile,
system instructions, and behavioral parameters for the AI assistant.
◦ How it works: It defines the agent's persona as a strict NASA science
assistant. It enforces anti-hallucination guardrails by instructing
the model to prioritize retrieved document chunks from the local
knowledge base and execute live API tools rather than relying on
unverified general knowledge. It also links the model's tool-calling
capabilities and knowledge collection routing and The source code of astrochatbot model export is:


https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gAtZRhDgUec3AT68HI00vsVkjfDCZKNe/view?usp=sharing

2. nasa_tool.py (Live NASA API Integration Script)
◦ Purpose: A custom Python module that connects the conversational
interface directly to official NASA REST endpoints (api.nasa.gov).
◦ Functions included:
▪ get_astronomy_picture_of_the_day(): Fetches the daily APOD title,
scientific explanation, and high-resolution image link.
▪ get_mars_weather_or_rover_photo(): Queries the Mars Rover Photos
